title: NuGet Catalog Event
description: A catalog event (leaf) in the NuGet Catalog API representing either a package details snapshot or a package deletion record. The catalog records the full history of all package operations on nuget.org.

@type.description: The type(s) of the catalog item. Includes either PackageDetails or PackageDelete, optionally with catalog:Permalink.

catalog:commitId.description: A unique identifier for the commit that produced this catalog item.

catalog:commitTimeStamp.description: The ISO 8601 timestamp when this item was committed to the catalog.

id.description: The package ID of the catalog item.

version.description: The package version string. For PackageDetails, this is normalized. For PackageDelete, this is the original .nuspec version.

published.description: For PackageDetails, when the package was last listed. For PackageDelete, when the package was deleted.

originalId.description: The original cased package ID. Present only in PackageDelete items.

created.description: When the package was first created. Present only in PackageDetails items.

authors.description: The package authors. Present only in PackageDetails items.

description.description: The package description. Present only in PackageDetails items.

isPrerelease.description: Whether the version is a prerelease. Present only in PackageDetails items.

listed.description: Whether the package is listed. Present only in PackageDetails items.

packageHash.description: Base 64 encoded hash of the .nupkg file. Present only in PackageDetails items.

packageHashAlgorithm.description: The hash algorithm used, typically SHA512. Present only in PackageDetails items.

packageSize.description: Size of the .nupkg file in bytes. Present only in PackageDetails items.

verbatimVersion.description: The version string as originally found in the .nuspec. Present only in PackageDetails items.
